verdict.rationale: Logseq documents a plugin API at plugins-doc.logseq.com, organized into namespaces such as logseq.App, logseq.Editor, logseq.DB and logseq.UI. Developers can load their own builds via 'Load unpacked plugin' and distribute through the Marketplace, so the core of building custom plugins against a documented API is delivered. The API docs are explicitly community-driven rather than first-party, and the pack contains no sample plugins; the only worked examples are HTTP API curl calls. Missing for 10: evidenced sample plugins or starter templates, first-party developer guides, independent or hands-on corroboration of plugin development.
